# lunar-java

Calendar festival / solar term / lunar date calculation uses `cn.6tail:lunar:1.7.7`.

- Upstream: https://github.com/6tail/lunar-java
- Version: https://github.com/6tail/lunar-java/tree/v1.7.7
- License: MIT; original copyright retained in `LICENSE`.
- Source of license: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/6tail/lunar-java/v1.7.7/LICENSE
- Packaged notice: `feature/calendar/src/main/assets/licenses/lunar-java-MIT.txt`.

The app calls `Solar.fromYmd`, solar / lunar festivals and solar terms. Daily fortune copy is local application content, not an upstream prediction or external service. No external calendar data request or private event upload is involved.

Since 0.16.1, Today also uses the same pinned library to provide the current festival name to the user-supplied weather copy matcher.
